White-label hosting means your clients experience *your* brand and deal with *you*, while a platform runs the servers behind the scenes.

The part you truly own is the client-facing layer: your reports, your invoice, your domain, your support. On the infrastructure side, what makes this work is per-client isolation and scoped access, so you run everything from one dashboard and each client only ever sees their own site. It doesn't require you to become a hosting company.

White-Label Hosting for Agencies, Explained Without the Jargon

Quick thread 🧵
White-label hosting means your clients experience *your* brand and deal with *you*, while a platform runs the servers behind the scenes.
The part you truly own is the client-facing layer: your reports, your invoice, your domain, your support.
On the infrastructure side, what makes this work is per-client isolation and scoped access, so you run everything from one dashboard and each client only ever sees their own site.
It doesn't require you to become a hosting company.
